§ 01 · The Program

A complete
curriculum.

From entry-level B1 to advanced C1 professional, every module is grounded in real-world construction scenarios — from project management and civil engineering to site safety and quality control, from procurement and contracts to sustainability and smart building technology. Built for use inside contractors, engineering firms, developers, and construction management programs.

GROUNDBREAK

Industry-anchored

Every question reflects the real terminology of global construction firms, contractors, and regulators in 2026.

FRAMEWORK

Standards-fluent

ISO 9001, OSHA, LEED, building codes — the technical language of the industry permeates the program.

INSPECT

Auto-graded

Instant scoring with executive-level performance feedback and targeted improvement guidance.

HANDOVER

Case-led pedagogy

Mini case studies bring real dilemmas — schedule delays, safety incidents, cost overruns — into language learning.

§ 03 · The Author

Brice Gadou

Construction Business English Expert

Brice Gadou is a Business English specialist dedicated to building world-class language training for international construction professionals. Keystone reflects his vision: language learning as structural capability — a multiplier of careers, safety, and entire project relationships.

Designed for the project managers, site engineers, contractors, and construction executives shaping the built environment — Keystone is more than vocabulary. It's the fluency to lead in the most demanding, physically consequential industry of our time.
